from datetime import datetime, timedelta

current_date_str, current_time_str = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time().values()
print('current_date_str:', current_date_str)
print('current_time_str:', current_time_str)

# Parse 'Wednesday, May 24, 2023'
cur_dt = datetime.strptime(current_date_str, '%A, %B %d, %Y')
print('parsed cur_dt:', cur_dt)

# Find upcoming Saturday (Saturday index=5 if Monday=0)
weekday = cur_dt.weekday() # Monday=0
sat_index = 5
# days until next Saturday (including if today Saturday?) we need upcoming Saturday night -> next occurrence >= today
if weekday <= sat_index:
    days_until = sat_index - weekday
else:
    days_until = 7 - (weekday - sat_index)
party_dt = cur_dt + timedelta(days=days_until)
# deadline: end of day before party
deadline_date = party_dt - timedelta(days=1)
print('party_date:', party_dt)
print('deadline_date (end of day):', deadline_date)

# In terms of delivery_days, today is at time from phone; approximate max delivery_days such that delivery arrives by end of deadline_date.
# We'll compute time delta from now to end-of-deadline_date (23:59:59)
# Need parse phone time like '09:45 AM'
now_time = datetime.strptime(current_time_str, '%I:%M %p').time()
now_dt = datetime.combine(cur_dt.date(), now_time)
end_deadline_dt = datetime.combine(deadline_date.date(), datetime.strptime('11:59 PM','%I:%M %p').time())
# Actually end of day use 23:59:59
end_deadline_dt = datetime.combine(deadline_date.date(), datetime.strptime('11:59 PM','%I:%M %p').time())
delta_hours = (end_deadline_dt - now_dt).total_seconds()/3600
max_days = delta_hours/24
print('now_dt:', now_dt)
print('end_deadline_dt:', end_deadline_dt)
print('max_days_float:', max_days)

# Upcoming Saturday (party night)
weekday = cur_dt.weekday()  # Monday=0
sat_index = 5
if weekday <= sat_index:
    days_until = sat_index - weekday
else:
    days_until = 7 - (weekday - sat_index)
party_dt = cur_dt + timedelta(days=days_until)

# Deadline: end of the day before the party
deadline_date = party_dt - timedelta(days=1)
end_deadline_dt = datetime.combine(deadline_date.date(), datetime.strptime('11:59 PM','%I:%M %p').time())
max_delivery_days = (end_deadline_dt - now_dt).total_seconds()/86400

print('Party Saturday:', party_dt.date())
print('Delivery deadline (end of day before):', deadline_date.date())
print('Max delivery_days allowed:', max_delivery_days)

# Invitees (coworker + roommate contacts)

invitees=[]
for rel in ['coworker','roommate']:
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship=rel, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break

# Selected candidate from prior search

shipment_ok = prod.get('delivery_days',1e9) <= max_delivery_days
